senses.gloss: m. (חֲגַג) drawing figures in the air, gesture.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 46b:14">Ber. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>מחוי ליה במ׳</he> he talks to him by gestures.

<cite ref="Chagigah 5b:4">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>גברא דלא ידע מאי מחוו ליה במ׳ וכ׳</he> (differ. in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) should a man who knows not what they indicate to him in gestures hold converse in signs before the King?
